messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Issue Installing RStan Windows 8
parts:
Have you installed Rtools and made sure that the compilers
are on your path?

It looks like it's not finding the compiler (g++) on your path.
See:

https://github.com/stan-dev/rstan/wiki/Install-Rtools-for-Windows

which also has a simple test to see if Rtools is installed properly.

- Bob

parts:
SO... special thing happened. I installed minGW and restarted the laptop, reinstalled rtools (same version) and tried again and it works. Mind, this was the third time of restarting and reinstalling rtools, so I think minGW did the trick. But, probably, we will never know.

Thank you Bob and Daniel for your help. It helped to know that I was not making some kind of silly mistake.

CHeers,
Tanja

Rtools32, since I have R 3.1.3
